results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The Booker Prize winners and page counts are edition-specific:

2025: David Szalay, *Flesh* — 349 pages in the UK edition; 368 pages in the US edition. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flesh_%28Szalay_novel%29))  
2024: Samantha Harvey, *Orbital* — 136 pages, as reported by the Booker Prize. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/orbital-by-samantha-harvey-wins-the-booker-prize-2024))  
2023: Paul Lynch, *Prophet Song* — 320 pages in the publisher’s edition. ([bloomsbury.com](https://www.bloomsbury.com/au/prophet-song-9780861546459/))

These search results are from the official Booker Prize site and publishers; the page counts refer to particular editions, not one universal count.

The 2025 Booker Prize winner was David Szalay for *Flesh*. The 2024 winner, Samantha Harvey’s *Orbital*, is 136 pages in its Booker-listed edition. Paul Lynch’s 2023 winner, *Prophet Song*, is listed as 336 pages by its publisher. Page counts can vary by edition. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2025))
